title: Local magnetic resonance of scalar spin chirality
summary: Quantum states with finite scalar spin chirality carry an orbital magnetic moment that has so far eluded direct measurement. We show that, whereas uniform electron spin resonance preserves chirality, a local drive breaks the cyclic symmetry and activates chirality-changing transitions, providing direct access to the chiral orbital magnetic moment. Lindblad simulations demonstrate experimentally accessible signatures in platforms with local spin addressability, including electron spin resonance with a scanning tunneling microscope, donor spins in silicon, and quantum-dot spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了具有有限标量自旋手性的量子态所携带的轨道磁矩，该磁矩此前无法直接测量。作者证明均匀电子自旋共振保持手性不变，而局域驱动打破循环对称性并激活手性改变跃迁，从而提供直接探测手性轨道磁矩的途径。Lindblad模拟展示了在具有局域自旋寻址能力的平台（如STM-ESR、硅中的施主自旋、量子点自旋量子比特）中可实验观测的可靠信号。
AI.motivation: 具有有限标量自旋手性的量子态自带轨道磁矩，但这一物理量至今缺乏直接测量手段，需要一种能够直接获取手性轨道磁矩的实验方案。
AI.method: 通过对比均匀驱动（保持手性）与局域驱动（打破循环对称性、激活手性改变跃迁）的自旋共振行为，利用Lindblad主方程模拟，在多个具有局域自旋寻址能力的实验平台中预测可观测的量子态演化特征。
AI.result: 局域驱动能够激活手性改变跃迁，为直接测量手性轨道磁矩提供了理论依据，并在STM-ESR、硅施主自旋和量子点自旋量子比特等平台中呈现出实验可及的特征信号。
AI.conclusion: 局域驱动是解锁和直接测量手性轨道磁矩的有效手段，相关方案在现代自旋量子实验平台中具有实际可行性。

title: Demonstration of a scalable all-solid-state refrigerator exploiting diffusion geometries and limiting interfacial conductances at temperatures below 1
summary: Solid-state refrigerators using Normal-metal/Insulator/Superconductor (NIS) junctions have previously demonstrated excellent electron cooling but limited ability to cool phonons. The energy gap of the superconductor is used as an energy filter to allow higher than average energy electrons to preferentially tunnel from the normal-metal through the insulator into the superconductor where they travel as quasi-particles. Typically, the heat is moved and work is done to deposit hot quasi-particles into a normal-metal quasi-particle trap for rejection to the next refrigeration stage. Realizing that (1) the quasi-particles flow diffusively, driven by a concentration gradient in the electric field-free superconductor, and (2) that the undesirable backwards leaking of heat from the hot-side trap can be reduced by engineering the geometry and materials at the superconductor-to-trap interface, enhanced cooling can be achieved. Fabrication of the refrigerator was accomplished using a tungsten and titanium-tungsten alloy as the cold-side normal-metal, aluminum oxide as the insulator, aluminum as the superconductor, and gold as the trap, with the cold-side NIS portion being attached to the hot-side gold trap by bump bonding. The refrigerator consisted of 1121 junction pairs, each pair being an SINIS unit, all electrically connected in series. Using this we have measured the effective phonon temperature of a 3.9 mm x 3.9 mm x 0.65 mm silicon chip driven down to 70 mK from a bath temperature of 120 mK, and down to 174 mK from a 271 mK rejection temperature (a cooling of -97 mK). This is the first demonstration of the sub 1 K cooling of an entire silicon chip using NIS junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种基于NIS（正常金属/绝缘体/超导体）结的固态制冷器，通过优化准粒子扩散流和超导体-陷阱界面的几何与材料设计减少热回流，成功实现了对整块硅芯片的亚开尔文（sub-1K）冷却，首次将3.9×3.9×0.65 mm硅芯片的有效声子温度从120 mK浴温降至70 mK。
AI.motivation: 固态NIS结制冷器此前已展现出优异的电子冷却能力，但在声子冷却方面存在局限。作者希望通过改进器件设计提高整体冷却性能，特别是实现对整个硅芯片的亚开尔文冷却。
AI.method: 利用超导体的能隙作为能量过滤器，使高能电子优先隧穿从冷端正常金属进入超导体成为准粒子；认识到准粒子在无电场超导体中由浓度梯度驱动扩散流动，并通过工程化超导体-陷阱界面的几何和材料减少热回流。器件采用钨/钛钨合金（冷端）、氧化铝（绝缘体）、铝（超导体）和金（陷阱），冷端NIS部分通过凸点键合连接到热端金陷阱，共1121对串联的SINIS单元。
AI.result: 在浴温120 mK下将硅芯片有效声子温度降至70 mK；从271 mK的排热温度降至174 mK（冷却幅度-97 mK）。这是首次利用NIS结实现对整个硅芯片的亚1K冷却演示。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化准粒子扩散和界面热回流抑制设计，NIS结制冷器能够实现整块硅芯片的亚开尔文冷却，为固态制冷在低温量子器件等领域的实际应用提供了可行路径。

title: Discovery of novel magnetic Y-Mn-B compounds via advanced machine learning guided framework
summary: Rare-earth transition-metal borides offer critical structural motifs for permanent-magnet design; however, the manganese-rich regions within these compositional phase spaces remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop an advanced machine-learning-assisted discovery framework to explore Y-Mn-B ternary system. Starting from over one million hypothetical structures generated from known structures in databases, we filtered promising candidates by first applying graph neural networks to predict material stability, then using machine-learning-interatomic-potential to relax their structures, and finally validating the results with first-principles calculations. We identify 5 stable and near-stable Y-Mn-B phases along with 61 metastable compounds with the formation energy within 100 meV/atom with respect to the ternary convex hull. Among them, Y2Mn7B7 and YMn4B4 are structurally analogous to the previously synthesized $R_{1+ε}Fe_4B_4$ 1D incommensurate composite chain compounds. In striking contrast to the strongly suppressed Fe moments reported, our first-principles calculations reveal that the predicted Mn-chain phases preserve sizable local Mn moments (approximately 1.1 $μ_B$) and favored ferromagnetic ordering. Electronic structure analyses elucidate the microscopic origin of moment recovery via an enhanced exchange splitting driven by a Stoner-like instability. We also perform systematic Mn-Fe substitution to confirm the thermodynamic continuity and a monotonic enhancement of the macroscopic magnetization, from Fe to Mn. These findings indicate that targeted transition-metal substitution within a one-dimensional boride family can recover transition-metal magnetism, offering a physically interpretable route for designing new magnetic rare-earth transition-metal borides.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种机器学习辅助的发现框架，探索Y-Mn-B三元体系中此前未被研究的富锰区域。通过从超过一百万个假设结构中筛选，识别出5个稳定/近稳定相和61个亚稳态化合物，其中Y2Mn7B7和YMn4B4与已知的R1+εFe4B4一维非公度复合链化合物结构类似。第一性原理计算表明这些Mn链相保留了约1.1 μB的局域磁矩并表现出铁磁有序，与Fe对应物中强烈抑制的磁矩形成鲜明对比。电子结构分析揭示了Stoner类不稳定性驱动的增强交换劈裂是磁矩恢复的微观机制。Mn-Fe取代研究证实了热力学连续性和从Fe到Mn的宏观磁化单调增强。
AI.motivation: 稀土过渡金属硼化物为永磁体设计提供了关键结构基序，但富锰区域的相空间尚未被充分探索，限制了发现新型磁性材料的可能性。
AI.method: 从数据库已知结构出发生成超过一百万个假设结构，先用图神经网络预测材料稳定性进行筛选，再用机器学习原子间势进行结构弛豫，最后用第一性原理计算验证候选结构。
AI.result: 识别出5个稳定/近稳定Y-Mn-B相和61个亚稳态化合物（形成能在三元凸包100 meV/atom以内）。Y2Mn7B7和YMn4B4具有与R1+εFe4B4类似的一维链结构，且Mn链相保持约1.1 μB的局域磁矩和铁磁有序，不同于Fe相位中被抑制的磁矩。电子结构分析揭示Stoner类不稳定驱动的增强交换劈裂是磁矩恢复的原因。Mn-Fe取代显示了热力学连续性和磁化强度从Fe到Mn的单调增强。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明在一维硼化物家族中进行针对性过渡金属取代可以恢复过渡金属磁性，为设计新型磁性稀土过渡金属硼化物提供了物理上可解释的途径。

title: Many-Anyon Braiding in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect with Hybrid Monte Carlo Simulation
summary: We employ the hybrid Monte Carlo method to efficiently compute the many-anyon non-Abelian braiding matrices associated with different braiding schemes of the Moore-Read quasiholes. A novel proposal in this work is that anyon braiding schemes based on a global rotation are robust against finite-size effects, as demonstrated by benchmarking their errors in the braiding matrix against those of a simple two-anyon exchange. Moreover, we investigate how electron-electron interactions and local electrostatic trapping potentials influence the energetic preference of different fusion channels. Their effect on the non-Abelian braiding matrices has been verified, a surprising phenomenon that demonstrates long-range entanglement of non-Abelian states. Our results are relevant to the experimental realization of non-Abelian physics in fractional quantum Hall and other analogous systems, including the fast-growing field of fractional quantum anomalous Hall states in moiré materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用混合蒙特卡洛方法高效计算Moore-Read准空穴在不同编织方案下的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵，提出基于全局旋转的编织方案对有限尺寸效应具有鲁棒性，并研究了电子-电子相互作用和局域静电势阱对不同融合通道能量偏好的影响，发现其对非阿贝尔编织矩阵的显著作用揭示了非阿贝尔态的长程纠缠特性。
AI.motivation: 非阿贝尔编织矩阵的计算对于实现拓扑量子计算至关重要，但已有方法在大规模多任意子体系中存在计算效率瓶颈，且传统编织方案对有限尺寸效应敏感，制约了数值结果的可靠性。同时，理解环境因素（如相互作用和静电势）对融合通道和编织矩阵的影响对于实验实现非阿贝尔物理具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用混合蒙特卡洛（hybrid Monte Carlo）方法高效计算多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵；提出基于全局旋转的编织方案以增强对有限尺寸效应的鲁棒性，并通过与简单双任意子交换的误差基准测试进行验证；系统研究电子-电子相互作用及局域静电势阱对不同融合通道能量偏好的影响，并检验其对编织矩阵的作用。
AI.result: 基于全局旋转的编织方案在有限尺寸效应下的误差显著低于传统双任意子交换方案，展现出良好鲁棒性；发现电子-电子相互作用和局域静电势阱能改变不同融合通道的能量偏好，且它们对非阿贝尔编织矩阵产生可观测的影响，验证了非阿贝尔态存在长程纠缠这一非平凡现象。
AI.conclusion: 本工作提供了更高效且对有限尺寸效应鲁棒的非阿贝尔编织矩阵计算方法，并揭示了相互作用和静电势对非阿贝尔编织物理的实质性影响，为分数量子霍尔系统及摩尔材料中分数量子反常霍尔态等平台上的非阿贝尔物理实验实现提供了理论指导。

title: Temporally Distinguishing Photocatalytic Dynamics
summary: Light can induce both photothermal and nonthermal catalytic activity in plasmonic nanoparticles, but the extent, timescale, and efficacy of these two mechanisms remain unresolved. Here we introduce pump-pump photocatalysis, an adaptation of ultrafast excitation correlation spectroscopy in which incident laser pulses are split into two spatially and energetically equivalent pulses separated by a variable time delay. For a given reaction and catalyst, time-sensitive nonlinear enhancements in photocatalytic activity may be distinguished from time-insensitive responses as a function of time delay, pulse power, excitation wavelength, applied temperature, reactant pressure, and pulse asymmetry. In this way, the timescales of photothermal and nonthermal activity of any photocatalyst may be monitored on sub picosecond to nanosecond timescales, and the conditions for optimal chemical reactivity may be discovered. Here we report ultrafast measurements of the ammonia decomposition reaction using a Cu-Ru antenna-reactor photocatalyst. Photothermal contributions exhibit little sensitivity to pulse delay, while nonthermal contributions are most apparent at low excitation intensity, moderate temperatures, and sub-nanosecond timescales. Here, nonlinear, nonthermal mechanisms enhance H$_2$ production by a factor up to eleven compared to when pulses overlap. This technique may be used to provide unprecedented \textit{in operando} diagnostics and control of any photocatalyst for any chemical reaction. Most importantly, these measurements allow us to ascertain the optimal distribution of light to maximize photocatalytic activity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"泵-泵光催化"（pump-pump photocatalysis）的新技术，该技术改编自超快激发相关光谱学，通过将入射激光脉冲分为两个空间和能量等效但时间延迟可变的脉冲，来区分等离子体纳米颗粒中的光热和非热催化活性。以Cu-Ru天线-反应器光催化剂上的氨分解反应为案例，发现光热贡献对脉冲延迟不敏感，而非热贡献在低激发强度、中等温度和亚纳秒时间尺度下最为显著，非线性非热机制可使H₂产量相对于脉冲重叠时提升多达11倍。
AI.motivation: 光可以诱导等离子体纳米颗粒产生光热和非热催化活性，但这两种机制的贡献程度、时间尺度和有效性一直不明确，需要一种方法能够区分并监测这两种机制。
AI.method: 引入泵-泵光催化技术（pump-pump photocatalysis），将激光脉冲分为两个空间和能量等效但时间延迟可变的脉冲。通过监测时间敏感的（非线性）与时间不敏感的（线性）光催化活性增强随延迟时间、脉冲功率、激发波长、温度、反应物压力和脉冲不对称性等因素的变化，区分光热和非热贡献。
AI.result: 对Cu-Ru天线-反应器光催化剂上的氨分解反应进行超快测量表明：光热贡献对脉冲延迟几乎不敏感，而非热贡献在低激发强度、中等温度和亚纳秒时间尺度下最为显著。非线性非热机制可使H₂产量比脉冲重叠时提高最多11倍。
AI.conclusion: 该技术可为任意光催化剂和化学反应提供前所未有的原位诊断和控制手段，并可用于确定最大化光催化活性的最优光照分布。

title: Over what length scale does an inorganic substrate perturb the structure of a glassy organic semiconductor?
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 55 references: Supplemental material (9 figures)
summary: While the bulk structure of vapor-deposited glasses has been extensively studied, structure at buried interfaces has received little attention, despite being important for organic electronic applications. To learn about glass structure at buried interfaces, we study the structure of vapor-deposited glasses of the organic semiconductor DSA-Ph (1,4-di-[4-(N,N-diphenyl)amino]styryl-benzene) as a function of film thickness; structure is probed with grazing incidence X-ray scattering. We deposit on silicon and gold substrates and span a film thickness range of 10-600 nm. Our experiments demonstrate that interfacial molecular packing in vapor-deposited glasses of DSA-Ph is more disordered compared to the bulk. At a deposition temperature near room temperature, we estimate ~ 8 nm near the substrate can have modified molecular packing. Molecular dynamics simulations of a coarse-grained representation of DSA-Ph reveal a similar length scale. In both the simulations and the experiments, deposition temperature controls glass structure beyond this interfacial layer of a few nanometers.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过掠入射X射线散射实验和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，揭示了气相沉积有机半导体DSA-Ph玻璃在埋藏界面处的分子堆积比体相更为无序，并估计界面改性层厚度约为8纳米。
AI.motivation: 气相沉积玻璃的体相结构已被广泛研究，但埋藏界面处的结构却鲜少受到关注，而这一区域对有机电子应用至关重要。
AI.method: 在硅和金属基底上沉积DSA-Ph玻璃，改变膜厚（10-600 nm），使用掠入射X射线散射探测结构；同时采用粗粒化分子动力学模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 发现界面处的分子堆积比体相更无序；在接近室温的沉积温度下，靠近基底约8 nm范围内存在改性分子堆积；模拟结果与实验一致，均显示沉积温度控制界面层之外的玻璃结构。
AI.conclusion: 埋藏界面处的分子堆积与体相存在显著差异，界面无序层厚度约数纳米，且沉积温度是调控界面层之外玻璃结构的关键参数。

title: Emissivity by Design: Geometric Mesh Inductance Governs Thermal Radiation in Metallic Nanowire Networks
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures. Main text (8 pages, 3 figures) followed by Supplementary Information (21 pages, 5 figures). REVTeX 4.2. Code and data: https://github.com/abaret-phys/emissivity-by-design
summary: The thermal infrared emissivity of metallic nanowire networks - the property that makes them candidate low-emissivity transparent electrodes - follows regularities that have resisted physical explanation: a strong wire-diameter dependence with no wire-length dependence, a correlation with sheet resistance that breaks down above ~15 ohm/sq, and an angular signature that turns from dielectric-like to metallic as the network densifies. We show that all of them follow from one local geometric length, the average inter-wire gap g, acting through the geometric inductance of a mesh finer than the thermal wavelength: $X_L = Z_0 (g/λ) \ln(2g/πD)$, a parameter-free reactance that exceeds the ohmic loss and, unlike the DC sheet resistance, stays finite instead of diverging at the percolation threshold. Since the gap is fixed by areal density and wire diameter alone, the optics is length-independent and decoupled from percolative transport; what has been read as a second, optical percolation is instead a smooth impedance crossing. With a single fitted parameter the theory reproduces 56 silver-nanowire samples across four diameters to a mean absolute error of 0.04, collapses them onto one universal curve, and - unchanged - predicts the emissivity-transmittance data of five independent groups and the measured spectral emissivity, including the silica phonon band. Because this reactance contains no material constant, the inter-wire gap emerges as the master design variable for the radiative properties of metallic nanowire transparent conductors.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示金属纳米线网络热红外发射率的规律统一源于一个局部几何长度——平均线间间隙g，通过几何电感起作用。该理论无材料常数，单一拟合参数即可在56个银纳米线样品上达到0.04的平均绝对误差，并可预测其他独立研究组的发射率-透过率数据。
AI.motivation: 金属纳米线网络作为低发射率透明电极候选材料，其热红外发射率表现出难以物理解释的规律：强线径依赖而无线长依赖、与方块电阻的相关性在~15 Ω/sq以上失效、以及随网络致密化从介质型向金属型转变的角度特征。现有理论无法统一解释这些现象。
AI.method: 提出所有规律均由单个局部几何长度——平均线间间隙g——通过几何电感决定：X_L = Z_0(g/λ)ln(2g/πD)，这是一个无参数的电抗，超过欧姆损耗，且不像直流方块电阻那样在渗流阈值处发散。间隙由面密度和线径固定，因此光学与线长无关且与渗流输运解耦；所谓"光学渗流"实为平滑的阻抗跨越。
AI.result: 理论以单一拟合参数复现56个银纳米线样品、四种线径的数据，平均绝对误差0.04，并将其坍缩到一条通用曲线上。无需修改即可预测五个独立研究组的发射率-透过率数据，以及测量的光谱发射率（包括二氧化硅声子带）。
AI.conclusion: 由于该电抗不含任何材料常数，线间间隙g成为金属纳米线透明导体辐射特性的主设计变量，为低发射率透明电极的理性设计提供了统一的物理框架。

title: Unconventional Pressure Evolution of Spin-Density-Wave State in La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$
summary: The discovery of pressure-induced high temperature superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$ has raised the question of how its spin-density-wave (SDW) state evolves toward the superconducting regime. Here, we report a systematic electronic Raman study of La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$ single crystals under hydrostatic pressures up to 16.51 GPa. Both the SDW gap energy and the transition temperature $T_{\mathrm{SDW}}$ show an overall increase with pressure, while the dimensionless coupling ratio 2$Δ_{\text{SDW}}/(k_{\text{B}}T_{\text{SDW}})$ remains constant around $\sim7.5$, indicating a robust strong-coupling character of SDW state. At the same time, the Raman SDW peak broadens as pressure is applied, indicating a gradual weakening of long-range SDW order. These results reveal an unusual pressure evolution in which the SDW energy scale is enhanced while the SDW state becomes progressively less coherent, providing spectroscopic constraints on the magnetic correlations relevant to superconductivity in bilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过电子拉曼散射光谱，在高达16.51 GPa的静水压力下系统研究了双层镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇单晶中自旋密度波（SDW）态随压力的演化，发现SDW能隙和转变温度均随压力升高而增大，但强耦合比保持恒定，同时SDW峰展宽表明长程有序逐渐减弱。
AI.motivation: 压力诱导的双层镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇中出现高温超导现象，这引发了关键问题：其自旋密度波（SDW）态如何演化为超导态？理解SDW态的压力演化对于揭示与超导相关的磁关联至关重要。
AI.method: 对La₃Ni₂O₇单晶在高达16.51 GPa的静水压力下进行系统的电子拉曼散射光谱测量，追踪SDW能隙能量、SDW转变温度T_SDW以及拉曼SDW峰宽随压力的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现SDW能隙能量和转变温度均随压力整体增加；无量纲耦合比2Δ_SDW/(k_B T_SDW)保持恒定在约7.5，表明SDW态具有稳健的强耦合特征；同时拉曼SDW峰随压力施加而展宽，表明长程SDW有序逐渐减弱。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了反常的压力演化行为：SDW能量尺度增强，但SDW态却逐渐变得不那么相干，为理解双层镍酸盐中与超导相关的磁关联提供了光谱学约束。

title: Incidence-based random walks on simplicial complexes
summary: We introduce an incidence-based random walk on the edges of a random two-dimensional simplicial complex with a complete $1$-skeleton and independently retained triangular faces. The dynamics combine two transport channels, one mediated by vertices and the other by triangular faces, through an effective transition operator controlled by a mixing parameter $q$. This construction isolates the effects of higher-order connectivity without modifying the underlying pairwise support of the walk. We characterize the model through structural observables, spectral relaxation, stationary localization, and first-passage transport. Our results show that partial face retention generates heterogeneous higher-order connectivity, giving rise to a pronounced transport bottleneck at intermediate face densities. In this regime, the second-largest eigenvalue modulus, the inverse participation ratio of the stationary distribution, and the mean first-passage time all exhibit non-monotonic behavior, reaching their largest values at intermediate face densities. The corresponding first-passage-time distributions reveal an enhanced probability of unusually long trajectories. Together, these results establish a simple framework for investigating how heterogeneous higher-order connectivity reshapes spectral and transport properties beyond pairwise network dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于关联(incidence)的随机游走模型，作用于具有完全1-骨架和随机保留三角形面的二维单纯复形上。通过混合参数q控制由顶点和三角形面介导的两条传输通道，系统研究了高阶连通性对谱松弛、平稳分布局域化和首达输运性质的影响，发现中间面密度下出现非单调的输运瓶颈现象。
AI.motivation: 传统网络动力学仅基于成对(pairwise)交互，忽略了高阶结构（如三角形面）对传输过程的影响。作者希望在不修改底层成对支撑结构的前提下，隔离并量化高阶连通性对谱性质和输运行为的贡献，建立一个简单框架来研究异构高阶连通性如何重塑超越成对网络动力学的传输特性。
AI.method: 在完全1-骨架的随机二维单纯复形上定义基于关联的边随机游走，通过混合参数q在顶点介导和三角面介导两个传输通道之间构建有效转移算子，并利用结构可观测量、谱松弛分析、平稳分布逆参与比(IPR)以及首达时间分布等工具对模型进行全面刻画。
AI.result: 部分面保留产生异构高阶连通性，在中间面密度区域出现显著输运瓶颈：第二大特征值模量、平稳分布逆参与比和平均首达时间均呈现非单调行为，在中间面密度处达到最大值；相应的首达时间分布显示异常长轨迹的概率增强。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个简洁的框架，证明异构高阶连通性能够显著重塑谱性质和输运特性，超越传统成对网络动力学的行为，为研究高阶交互系统的传输机制提供了新的理论工具。

title: Giant Bandgap Pulsation Driven by Hotspot Breathing Phonons in a Flat-Band Solid
summary: The electronic bandgap of solids is conventionally viewed as a static property at a given temperature, with only weak and stochastic thermal fluctuations under equilibrium conditions. Here, using ab initio molecular dynamics and first-principles electron-phonon calculations, we reveal a pronounced room-temperature bandgap pulsation at about 7.8 THz in a perovskite-like flat-band solid, with a maximum peak-to-peak variation approaching 0.95 eV. This behavior originates from a dual selection mechanism: the A1g-like breathing branch couples much more strongly to the flat conduction-band edge than other phonon branches, while real-space phase selectivity distinguishes its hotspot gamma-point and finite-q components. Although finite-q modes retain appreciable microscopic coupling, their intercell phase shifts produce smaller-amplitude shorter-recurrence-period responses, leaving the unit-cell-synchronous gamma-point A1g component to dominate the fundamental-period bandgap pulsation. The resulting band-edge dynamics further modulates the optical response on femtosecond timescales. These findings demonstrate that an unexpectedly ordered electronic response can emerge from intrinsically disordered thermal lattice fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从头算分子动力学和第一性原理电子-声子计算，揭示了一种类钙钛矿平带固体在室温下存在约7.8 THz的带隙脉动现象，峰值变化接近0.95 eV。该现象源于双重选择机制：A1g类呼吸振动分支与平带导带边的耦合远强于其他声子分支，且实空间相位选择性区分了其热点伽马点和有限q分量。有限q模式虽有显著的微观耦合，但其胞间相移产生更小振幅、更短重现周期的响应，使单胞同步的伽马点A1g分量主导基础周期的带隙脉动。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为固体电子带隙在给定温度下是静态属性，热涨落仅产生微弱随机影响。作者希望探索在本质上无序的热晶格涨落中，是否可能存在有序且显著的电子响应——即室温下大幅度的、周期性的带隙脉动现象，从而挑战对带隙静态性的传统理解。
AI.method: 采用从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟晶格热运动，并结合第一性原理电子-声子耦合计算，分析不同声子分支对平带导带边的耦合强度。通过实空间与动量空间的对比分析，识别A1g类呼吸振动分支中伽马点分量与有限q分量的不同贡献，从而解析带隙脉动的物理机制。
AI.result: 在类钙钛矿平带固体中观测到约7.8 THz的室温带隙脉动，峰峰变化幅度接近0.95 eV。A1g类呼吸分支的伽马点分量因单胞同步振动而产生最大振幅、基础周期的带隙脉动；有限q分量虽具有相当的微观耦合但受胞间相移影响，响应较小且重现周期更短。该带边动力学还进一步在飞秒时间尺度上调制光学响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，本质上无序的热晶格涨落可以产生出乎意料的、高度有序的电子响应——即大幅周期性带隙脉动。这一发现改变了人们对固体带隙作为静态属性的传统认知，揭示了平带系统中声子选择性和相位相干性在电子动力学中的重要作用，为飞秒时间尺度的光学调控提供了新的物理基础。

title: Absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities in a class of $U(1)$-symmetric spin-1 chains
summary: We prove the absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities in a class of $U(1)$-symmetric spin-$1$ chains with nearest-neighbor interactions in which some of the quadrupolar couplings vanish, a class that is not covered by previous studies. Applying the technique of Shiraishi to these systems, we show that, for every model in this class on a periodic chain of $N$ sites, there is no $k$-local conserved quantity for any $3\le k\le N/2$. In particular, for a frustration-free spin-$1$ chain that exhibits spontaneous $U(1)$ symmetry breaking at zero temperature in one spatial dimension, we prove that every local conserved quantity with support up to half of the system size is a linear combination of the identity, the total magnetization $S^z$, and the Hamiltonian itself. This rigorously establishes that, unlike the Heisenberg ferromagnet, the model admits no local order parameter commuting with the Hamiltonian, so that its continuous symmetry breaking is enabled by the frustration-free structure rather than by a conserved order parameter. We also prove the absence of $k$-local conserved quantities for $3\le k\le N/2$ in the periodic Motzkin chain, a frustration-free spin-$1$ chain closely related to the original Motzkin chain, for which spontaneous $U(1)$ symmetry breaking at zero temperature has also been reported.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一类具有U(1)对称的spin-1链（其中部分四极耦合消失）不存在非平凡局域守恒量，覆盖了以往研究未涉及的模型类别。利用Shiraishi技术，证明了周期链上3≤k≤N/2范围内不存在k-局域守恒量，并严格论证了无阻挫spin-1链的连续对称性破缺源于无阻挫结构而非守恒序参量。
AI.motivation: 已有研究未能覆盖一类具有U(1)对称的spin-1链（部分四极耦合项消失的模型）。此外，理解无阻挫自旋链中自发U(1)对称性破缺的本质机制（是否依赖于局域守恒量）是一个重要的理论问题。
AI.method: 应用Shiraishi技术，对一类U(1)对称的spin-1链（部分四极耦合消失）和周期Motzkin链，系统地证明不存在3≤k≤N/2范围内的k-局域守恒量。该方法通过严格的数学论证排除了局域守恒量的存在性。
AI.result: 证明了：(1) 目标模型类中不存在任何k-局域守恒量(3≤k≤N/2)；(2) 对于一维无阻挫spin-1链，所有支持范围不超过半系统大小的局域守恒量都只是单位算符、总磁化强度S^z和哈密顿量的线性组合；(3) 周期Motzkin链同样不存在3≤k≤N/2的k-局域守恒量。由此表明该模型与海森堡铁磁体不同，不存在与哈密顿量对易的局域序参量。
AI.conclusion: 该模型的自发U(1)对称性破缺是由无阻挫结构实现的，而非依赖于守恒序参量。这为理解一维量子系统中连续对称性自发破缺的机制提供了新的严格理论依据。

title: Chiral rotational dynamics in the molecular frame: Breaking symmetry with angular momentum
summary: Achiral molecules can be prepared in superposition states that are chiral. Here, we propose angular momentum orientation in the molecular frame to achieve the required symmetry breaking, exerting rotational control without the need for laboratory frame orientation. We derive the conditions for chiral rotational dynamics from the requirement to simultaneously break the continuous spatial rotational symmetry and the molecular point group symmetry. This can be achieved by three microwave pulses as well as two non-resonant optical pulses in combination with a THz pulse or three THz pulses, all with mutually orthogonal polarization directions, and the ensuing dynamics can be probed by photoelectron circular dichroism. Our results open the way for distinguishing structural from dynamical enantioselectivity and investigating time-odd chiroptical phenomena in randomly oriented molecules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在分子坐标系中实现角动量取向，通过同时打破连续空间旋转对称性和分子点群对称性来制备手性叠加态，无需实验室坐标系取向。通过三个微波脉冲或两个非共振光脉冲与THz脉冲组合（或三个THz脉冲），且偏振方向相互正交，可实现手性转动动力学，并用光电子圆二色性进行探测。
AI.motivation: 非手性分子可以被制备成手性的叠加态，但现有方法通常需要实验室框架下的取向。作者希望在不依赖实验室框架取向的情况下实现对称性破缺，从而制备手性叠加态，并区分结构手性与动力学手性选择性。
AI.method: 提出在分子坐标系中实现角动量取向（angular momentum orientation）的方法。核心是通过同时打破连续空间旋转对称性和分子点群对称性来实现手性转动动力学。具体方案包括：(1)三个微波脉冲；(2)两个非共振光学脉冲加一个THz脉冲；(3)三个THz脉冲，所有脉冲的偏振方向相互正交。动力学通过光电子圆二色性探测。
AI.result: 推导出了实现手性转动动力学的条件，证明可以通过上述多种脉冲组合方案，在随机取向分子中实现手性叠加态的制备，并通过光电子圆二色性进行探测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为区分结构手性与动力学手性选择性开辟了新途径，并为在随机取向分子中研究时间奇宇称（time-odd）手性光学现象提供了可能。

title: Temperature-Induced Reorganization of Supported Zn$_3$ Clusters on Cu(111): From Minimum-Energy Structures to Finite-Temperature Ensembles
summary: Understanding the nature of catalytic active sites under reaction conditions remains a central challenge in heterogeneous catalysis. In industrial copper/zinc oxide/alumina catalysts for methanol synthesis, small Zn-based species at the Cu interface have long been proposed as active-site candidates, yet their atomic-scale structure and stability remain controversial. Computational studies typically identify such species from optimized 0 K structures, assuming that minimum-energy configurations remain representative under reaction conditions. Here, we combine machine-learning-interatomic-potential-accelerated global optimization, molecular dynamics, and enhanced-sampling free-energy calculations to investigate supported Zn$_3$(OH)$_3$ and Zn$_3$(OH)$_2$CHOO clusters on Cu(111)-based surfaces from 0 to 450 K. While compact triangular configurations are generally favored among minimum-energy structures at 0 K, finite-temperature free-energy calculations reveal a pronounced shift toward extended linear configurations with increasing temperature. This transition is driven primarily by entropic stabilization and cannot be inferred from potential energies alone. Molecular dynamics further shows substantial cluster mobility on pristine Cu(111), indicating that long-term persistence depends not only on configurational stability but also on surface mobility. Surface Zn alloying strongly suppresses diffusion, thereby stabilizing isolated interfacial Zn species. Together, these results show that thermodynamically relevant structures of supported Zn-based clusters can differ fundamentally from static 0 K predictions because of competing enthalpic and entropic effects. Our findings highlight the limitations of identifying catalytic active sites solely from 0 K structures and underscore the importance of explicit finite-temperature sampling in catalyst modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机器学习势加速的全局优化、分子动力学和增强采样自由能计算，研究了Cu(111)表面上Zn₃(OH)₃和Zn₃(OH)₂CHOO团簇从0 K到450 K的结构演化。研究发现，虽然0 K最小能量结构偏好紧凑三角形构型，但有限温度下自由能计算揭示出向延伸线性构型的显著转变，这主要由熵驱动，无法仅从势能推断。分子动力学还显示团簇在纯Cu(111)上具有显著迁移性，而Zn合金化能强烈抑制扩散并稳定孤立界面Zn物种。
AI.motivation: 工业铜/氧化锌/氧化铝甲醇合成催化剂中，Cu界面上的小尺寸Zn基物种被认为是活性位点候选，但其原子尺度结构和稳定性仍存争议。传统计算研究通常从0 K优化的最小能量结构中识别活性位点，假设最低能量构型在反应条件下仍具代表性，这种假设可能存在根本性局限。
AI.method: 结合机器学习原子间势加速的全局优化方法搜索最低能量结构；采用分子动力学模拟研究团簇在表面上的动力学行为和迁移性；利用增强采样自由能计算方法评估从0到450 K温度范围内的热力学稳定性，比较不同构型间的自由能差异。
AI.result: 0 K下紧凑三角形构型通常最稳定，但随温度升高，自由能计算显示体系显著偏向延伸线性构型，该转变主要由熵稳定化驱动。分子动力学表明团簇在纯净Cu(111)上有显著迁移性，而表面Zn合金化能强烈抑制扩散，从而稳定孤立界面Zn物种。
AI.conclusion: 支撑Zn基团簇的热力学相关结构可能因焓熵竞争效应而从根本上不同于静态0 K预测。仅从0 K结构识别催化活性位点存在局限性，催化剂建模中必须显式考虑有限温度采样。

title: Zero Point Density Fluctuations and Electron Brownian Motion
summary: The fluctuations in the phonon vacuum state can lead to zero point density fluctuations in a material, which in turn lead to local zero point fluctuations of the dielectric properties of the material. We argue that the density fluctuations lead to a fluctuating force on a test charge, such as an electron, located a short distance outside of the material. This force is due to fluctuating dipole moments inside the material, and produces Brownian motion of the electron. We calculate the mean squared velocity of the electron in both the normal and transverse direction relative to the boundary of the material. The result is nonzero in both directions, but larger in the normal case. We estimate the magnitude of this quantum Brownian motion and find that, in some cases, it can exceed the effects of both thermal motion and quantum momentum uncertainty. This suggests that the effect may be observable, and could constitute a source of quantum noise in nanoscale devices. It also potentially offers a means to remotely sense zero point density fluctuations in a material.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了材料中声子真空态的涨落会导致零点密度涨落，进而引起材料介电性质的局部零点涨落。这些密度涨落会在材料外部附近的测试电荷（如电子）上产生涨落力（由材料内部涨落偶极矩引起），导致电子的布朗运动。作者计算了电子在法向和横向的均方速度，发现两个方向均非零但法向更大，并估计该量子布朗运动的量级在某些情况下可超过热运动和量子动量不确定性的影响，可能构成纳米器件的量子噪声源，并有望用于远程感知材料的零点密度涨落。
AI.motivation: 探究声子真空态涨落通过材料介电性质涨落对材料外部电荷产生的力学效应，评估其可观测性及其作为纳米器件量子噪声源的潜力。
AI.method: 从声子真空态密度涨落引起介电性质局部涨落出发，推理材料内部涨落偶极矩对材料外部测试电荷产生涨落力，进而计算电子在法向和横向方向的布朗运动均方速度，并与热运动和量子动量不确定性进行比较。
AI.result: 计算结果在法向和横向方向均非零，但法向分量更大；在某些情况下该量子布朗运动的量级可超过热运动效应和量子动量不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 该量子布朗运动效应可能可观测，可作为纳米尺度器件的量子噪声来源，并可能提供一种远程感知材料零点密度涨落的手段。

title: Bridging ambient- and high-pressure superconductivity in La$_2$LnNi$_2$O$_7$ films
summary: The discovery of high critical-temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity near 80 K in bilayer nickelates under high pressure has sparked extensive studies. While superconductivity exceeding 40 K was subsequently discovered at ambient pressure in compressively strained films, the relationship between ambient- and high-pressure regimes remains an open question. Here we present a systematic investigation of superconductivity in compressively strained La$_2$LnNi$_2$O$_7$ films (Ln = lanthanides) at ambient and high pressures. The normal-state resistivity at ambient pressure, revealed by suppressing superconductivity with magnetic fields of 59 T, tends toward $T^2$ behaviour. Under high pressure in a cubic-anvil cell, $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ was enhanced from 41-42 K at ambient pressure to 67-73 K at 16 GPa. On the other hand, lattice compression induced by Ln substitution, which may mimic effects of pressure, lowers $T_{\mathrm{c}}$. In both cases, $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ correlates with the evolution of normal-state transport between $T^2$ and $T$-linear behaviour, offering insight into the interplay between lattice structure and superconductivity in bilayer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了压缩应变La₂LnNi₂O₇薄膜（Ln=镧系元素）在常压和高压下的超导电性。常压下用59 T磁场抑制超导后，发现正常态电阻率趋向T²行为；而在立方砧压机施加高压时，T_c从常压的41-42 K提升至16 GPa下的67-73 K。然而，通过Ln取代导致的晶格压缩反而降低了T_c。两种情况下，T_c均与正常态输运行为在T²和T-linear之间的演化相关联，揭示了双层镍酸盐中晶格结构与超导电性之间的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 双层镍酸盐在高压下发现近80 K的高温超导电性，随后在压缩应变薄膜中于常压下发现超过40 K的超导电性，但常压与高压两个区域之间的关系尚不清楚。作者希望通过系统研究来阐明这一开放问题。
AI.method: 在压缩应变的La₂LnNi₂O₇薄膜（Ln=镧系元素）上，采用59 T强磁场抑制超导以揭示常压正常态电阻率行为；使用立方砧压机施加高压（至16 GPa）研究T_c的压力依赖性；同时通过Ln取代进行化学压压缩晶格以对比研究。
AI.result: 常压正常态电阻率趋向T²行为；高压下T_c从41-42 K提升至67-73 K（16 GPa）；而Ln取代导致的晶格压缩降低了T_c。T_c与正常态输运行为（T²与T-linear之间演化）存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现晶格结构与超导电性在双层镍酸盐中存在密切关联，T_c随正常态输运从T²向T-linear演化而提升，为理解常压与高压超导区域的关系提供了新见解，但也揭示了单纯的晶格压缩（化学压）与物理压力对T_c影响的不同之处。

title: Spontaneous symmetry-breaking in equilibrium tree-packing configurations of a kinetically constrained cubic-lattice system
summary: We explore kinetic-constraint induced thermodynamic phase transition in the cubic lattice, employing the Fredrikson-Anderson spin model with hyperparameter $K=2$ as a representative kinetic system. Each lattice site may flip its binary occupation state if at most one of its six nearest neighbors is currently occupied. The whole set of microscopic configurations that are kinetically connected with the fully empty one is described by an equilibrium partition function with a single global constraint, that is, the occupied sites do not form closed loops but instead organize into different tree components in the lattice. We discover a continuous thermodynamic gas--crystal phase transition in the cubic system and determine the critical chemical potential $μ^* \approx -3.252$, at which the occupied sites of the equilibrium tree-packing configurations start to prefer one of the two nested cubic sublattices. This thermodynamic phase transition is absent in the two-dimensional square lattice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究立方晶格中由动力学约束诱导的热力学相变，采用Fredrikson-Anderson自旋模型（超参数K=2）作为代表性动力学系统。研究发现立方体系中存在连续的气体-晶体相变，临界化学势μ*≈-3.252，此时占据位点偏好两个嵌套立方子晶格之一。这种相变在二维正方晶格中不存在。
AI.motivation: 探索动力学约束如何诱导热力学相变，理解受限动力学系统（如玻璃态）中的平衡态结构和相变行为，特别是维度对这类相变存在性的影响。
AI.method: 采用Fredrikson-Anderson自旋模型，每个格点只有在六个最近邻中至多有一个被占据时才能翻转其二元占据状态。将动力学连通的全空配置集合映射为具有单一全局约束的平衡配分函数，即占据位点不形成闭合环，而组织成不同的树状分量。通过分析占据位点对两个嵌套立方子晶格的偏好来检测相变。
AI.result: 在立方晶格中发现连续的气体-晶体热力学相变，临界化学势μ*≈-3.252。在临界点处，平衡树填充配置的占据位点开始偏好两个嵌套立方子晶格之一。该相变在二维正方晶格中不存在，表明维度对动力学约束诱导的相变具有关键影响。
AI.conclusion: 动力学约束可以在三维立方晶格中诱导出连续的热力学相变（气体-晶体转变），并且这种相变是三维特有的现象，在二维系统中不出现。这揭示了动力学约束与热力学相变之间的深层联系，以及维度在其中的关键作用。

title: Conditional-path Monte Carlo for rare stochastic dynamics on networks: Details and derivations
summary: The simulation of rare macroscopic events in stochastic network dynamics, such as widespread epidemic outbreaks, cascading failures in communication networks, or the escape from metastable states in many-body systems, is severely hindered by methodological challenges like catastrophic rejection rates, weight degeneracy, genealogical correlations, and critical slowing down inherent to standard forward-time algorithms, splitting methods, and transition-path sampling. Conditional-path Monte Carlo (CPMC) overcomes these limitations by employing non-local Swendsen-Wang-like cluster updates that operate directly on full-system trajectories. Serving as the technical companion to [Sun, Moody, and Barthel, arXiv:2608.16171], this paper provides the rigorous mathematical foundations and algorithmic details underlying the CPMC framework. We formally define the joint path-graph probability weights and derive the transition and uniformization sum rules that guarantee detailed balance. Applying the framework to susceptible-infectious-susceptible (SIS) models, we systematically construct and optimize single-node and edge graph vertex sets specifically designed to prevent lock avalanches and maintain the structural mobility of the epidemic trunk. Furthermore, we detail a dynamic programming scheme to exactly implement complex boundary conditions - including patient-zero and macroscopic outbreak-size constraints - enabling the rejection-free generation of valid trajectories. Finally, we assess the computational complexity of the algorithm, describe parallelization strategies, and validate CPMC against exact solutions for dynamics on small networks.

AI.tldr: 本文是Conditional-path Monte Carlo (CPMC)框架的技术配套论文，提供其严格的数学基础和算法细节。CPMC通过非局部的Swendsen-Wang类簇更新直接在完整系统轨迹上操作，克服了模拟稀有宏观事件（如广泛流行病暴发、级联故障、亚稳态逃逸）时标准算法面临的拒绝率高、权重退化、系谱相关和临界减速等问题。论文形式化定义了联合路径-图概率权重，推导了保证细致平衡的转移和均匀化求和规则，并针对SIS模型系统地构建和优化了图顶点集，同时提供了动态规划方案以精确实现复杂边界条件。
AI.motivation: 模拟随机网络动力学中的稀有宏观事件（如大规模流行病暴发、通信网络级联故障、多体系统亚稳态逃逸）是极具挑战性的问题。标准的前向时间算法、分裂方法和转移路径采样方法都面临灾难性拒绝率、权重退化、系谱相关性和临界减速等根本性方法学障碍，迫切需要一种能够克服这些局限的新型采样框架。
AI.method: 论文为CPMC框架提供严格的数学基础：(1) 形式化定义联合路径-图概率权重，推导转移求和规则和均匀化求和规则以确保细致平衡；(2) 将框架应用于SIS模型，系统构建和优化单节点与边图顶点集，设计上防止锁定雪崩并保持流行病毒干的结构流动性；(3) 提出动态规划方案精确实现复杂边界条件（包括零号病人和宏观暴发规模约束），实现无拒绝的有效轨迹生成；(4) 评估算法计算复杂度并描述并行化策略。
AI.result: 论文成功建立了CPMC框架的严格数学基础，证明了保证细致平衡所需的求和规则，设计了对SIS模型有效的图顶点集构建和优化方案，实现了精确的边界条件处理，并在小规模网络上通过精确解验证了CPMC算法的正确性。
AI.conclusion: CPMC通过非局部簇更新从根本上规避了传统稀有事件模拟方法的多重困境，为随机网络动力学中稀有宏观事件的模拟提供了可靠且高效的替代方案。该框架具有进一步推广到其他动力学模型和更大规模系统的潜力。

title: Inducing metal-insulator transition via disorder in correlated kagome systems
comment: Accepted for publication in Physical Review B
summary: The metal-insulator transition is often accompanied by fascinating quantum phenomena, including superconducting domes, antiferromagnetic phase transitions, and quantum spin liquids. Concurrently, kagome materials are predominantly metallic, necessitating the realization of insulating states to fully exploit their significant potential in logic and optoelectronic device applications. To address this, we investigate the electronic transport and magnetic properties in correlated kagome systems with hopping disorder using the determinant quantum Monte Carlo method. Through comprehensive analysis of the kinetic energy, dc conductivity, and density of states at the Fermi level, we demonstrate that the cooperative interplay between hopping disorder and electron correlations promotes electron localization. Within the insulator, an increase in the disorder level reduces the Coulomb interaction required for the Mott transition. Additionally, while disorder partially suppresses antiferromagnetic ordering, it remains insufficient to induce a complete magnetic transition. Finally, we summarize two schematic regions distinguishing between antiferromagnetic metal, correlated Anderson insulator, and disordered Mott insulator. Our study advances the understanding of metal-insulator transition in kagome systems by disorder and provides actionable insights for experimental control of these transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法研究了具有跳跃无序的相关kagome体系中的电子输运和磁性质。研究发现跳跃无序与电子关联的协同作用促进了电子局域化，无序程度的增加降低了Mott转变所需的库仑相互作用强度，并部分抑制了反铁磁有序。作者总结了区分反铁磁金属、关联Anderson绝缘体和无序Mott绝缘体的两个示意图区域。
AI.motivation: 金属-绝缘体转变常伴随超导穹顶、反铁磁相变和量子自旋液体等迷人量子现象，而kagome材料通常为金属性，实现绝缘态对于充分发挥其在逻辑和光电器件应用中的潜力至关重要。因此需要研究无序对kagome体系金属-绝缘体转变的影响。
AI.method: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant quantum Monte Carlo）方法，对具有跳跃无序（hopping disorder）的关联kagome体系进行数值模拟，综合分析动能、直流电导率和费米能级态密度等物理量。
AI.result: 跳跃无序与电子关联的协同作用促进电子局域化；在绝缘体内，无序程度的增加降低了Mott转变所需的库仑相互作用强度；无序部分抑制反铁磁有序，但不足以引发完整的磁性转变。
AI.conclusion: 研究总结出区分反铁磁金属、关联Anderson绝缘体和无序Mott绝缘体的两个示意图区域，推进了对kagome体系中无序介导的金属-绝缘体转变的理解，为实验控制这些转变提供了可行的见解。

title: Operando multidimensional spectroscopy reveals A-site-dependent carrier cooling in perovskite solar cells
summary: Understanding how photogenerated carriers dissipate excess energy in operating perovskite solar cells is essential for connecting ultrafast photophysics with photovoltaic function and provides design principles for engineering next-generation cell architectures. Here we use photocurrent-detected two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (PC-2DES) to resolve energy-dependent carrier relaxation in fully encapsulated, functioning metal halide perovskite solar cells. By comparing devices with identical architecture but different absorber compositions - MAPbI3, mixed FAMA, and FAPbI3 - we directly follow the redistribution of photoexcited carriers from initially populated high-energy states toward lower-energy band-edge states. The multidimensional photocurrent response reveals a cascade-like intraband cooling process whose rate depends strongly on absorber composition, with the slowest relaxation in MA-based devices, intermediate behaviour in mixed-cation devices, and fastest relaxation in FA-based devices. A reduced kinetic model incorporating phonon-mediated intraband scattering, supplemented by a phenomenological many-body contribution, captures the main energy-dependent trends. These results establish action-detected multidimensional spectroscopy as a device-level probe of ultrafast energy dissipation and show that subtle changes in perovskite composition can substantially reshape the carrier relaxation pathways that precede charge extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文使用光电流检测的二维电子光谱（PC-2DES）技术，在功能完整的钙钛矿太阳能电池中分辨能量依赖的载流子弛豫过程。通过比较三种不同钙钛矿组分（MAPbI3、混合FAMA、FAPbI3）的器件，揭示了级联式的带内冷却过程，其速率强烈依赖于钙钛矿组分，并建立了包含声子介导带内散射和多体效应的动力学模型来捕捉主要趋势。
AI.motivation: 理解工作状态下的钙钛矿太阳能电池中光生载流子如何耗散多余能量，对于连接超快光物理与光伏功能至关重要，可为下一代电池架构的工程设计提供设计原则。现有研究缺乏在功能性器件层面直接解析能量依赖的载流子弛豫途径的手段。
AI.method: 采用光电流检测的二维电子光谱（PC-2DES）技术，对全封装的金属卤化物钙钛矿太阳能电池进行测量。对比三种仅吸收层组分不同的器件（MAPbI3、混合FAMA、FAPbI3），追踪光生载流子从高能初始态向低能带边态的重新分布。构建包含声子介导带内散射的简化动力学模型，并辅以唯象多体贡献来拟合实验数据。
AI.result: 多维光电流响应揭示了级联式的带内冷却过程，其速率强烈依赖于钙钛矿组分：MA基器件弛豫最慢，混合阳离子器件居中，FA基器件弛豫最快。所构建的动力学模型能够捕捉主要的能量依赖趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了以作用检测（action-detected）的多维光谱作为器件层面超快能量耗散探测工具的可行性，并表明钙钛矿组分的细微变化能显著重塑载流子提取前的弛豫路径，为高性能钙钛矿太阳能电池的组分工程提供指导。

title: Flux-tunable global and local superconductivity in a topological insulator nano-SQUID
comment: Main text: 8 pages, 4 figures. SM: 7 pages, 5 figures
summary: Topological systems are defined by global properties that enforce the existence of local boundary modes. Three-dimensional topological insulators (TIs) were among the earliest proposed systems for hosting topological superconductivity, but experimental focus subsequently shifted to other platforms. Here, we revisit bulk-insulating TIs using a columnar nano-superconducting quantum interference device (nano-SQUID) architecture. This geometry optimises the proximity effect on the TI surface and enables simultaneous probing of global superconducting properties - via the critical current through the nano-SQUID - alongside the local states at the ends of the nano-SQUID via tunnel junctions. We observe several global superconducting features that appear to show a flux-driven global phase transition consistent with entering the topological regime, including periodic critical current oscillations and a sign reversal in the superconducting diode effect. Simultaneously, tunnelling spectroscopy reveals spectral jumps in local and nonlocal conductance that align with these global features. However, zero-bias peaks (ZBPs) in local conductance are present both within the predicted topological range of magnetic fields and in theoretically trivial regimes, including at zero magnetic field. Ultimately, the lack of correlation between local ZBP signatures and global signatures emphasises that conclusively identifying Majorana bound states will necessitate a combined approach, integrating the establishment of global topological properties with the use of local and other, more advanced, probes.

AI.tldr: 本文利用柱状纳米超导量子干涉仪（nano-SQUID）架构重新研究三维拓扑绝缘体，同时探测全局超导性质（临界电流、超导二极管效应）和局部边界态（隧道谱）。观察到通量驱动的全局相变迹象及零偏压峰，但局部与全局信号缺乏关联，表明仅凭局部信号无法确凿鉴定马约拉纳束缚态。
AI.motivation: 三维拓扑绝缘体是最早被提出用于承载拓扑超导的平台之一，但实验焦点随后转向其他体系。作者希望重新审视这一平台，并利用优化的几何结构来同时表征全局超导性质与局部拓扑态，以厘清拓扑超导的判定标准。
AI.method: 采用柱状nano-SQUID架构，其几何结构优化了拓扑绝缘体表面的近邻效应。通过临界电流测量获得全局超导特性，通过隧道结同时探测量子干涉仪末端的局域态。在磁场变化下联合分析全局电输运信号与局域/非局域隧道谱。
AI.result: 观察到周期性临界电流振荡和超导二极管效应符号反转等全局超导特征，表明存在与进入拓扑区相一致的磁通驱动全局相变。隧道谱中局域与非局域电导的谱跳变与全局特征对齐。但零偏压峰在拓扑预测磁场范围内及理论平凡区（包括零磁场）均存在，且与全局信号无关联。
AI.conclusion: 局部零偏压峰与全局拓扑特征的缺失关联，强调仅靠局部探针无法可靠鉴定马约拉纳束缚态，必须将全局拓扑性质的建立与局部及更先进探针相结合，才能得出确切结论。

title: Entropy mapping under uniaxial pressure utilizing the elastocaloric effect
summary: Uniaxial pressure is a powerful tuning parameter for quantum materials, but conventional thermodynamic probes such as specific heat are difficult to realize in the constrained geometries of strain apparatus. We develop a quantitative analysis framework for a.c. elastocaloric effect measurements that enable the reconstruction of the absolute entropy and hence specific heat across complex phase diagrams. The absolute accuracy is achieved by combining measurements in the strong coupling regime at low frequencies with high signal-to-noise measurements in the quasi-adiabatic regime at high frequencies. Applying the approach to the correlated superconductor Sr$_2$RuO$_4$, we obtain an absolute entropy map across the phase diagram including across phase transitions deep into the superconducting state. We demonstrate that from such data one can derive the absolute specific heat which is currently not possible through other approaches. This data reinforces the finding that the quenching of entropy within the superconductor Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ is strongest at the critical strain consistent with the superconducting gap being maximized at the Van Hove singularity (VHs). Furthermore, we demonstrate that, although $Δc /(γT) $ does increase at the VH strain, this increase is much weaker than previously inferred from more indirect caloric experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种定量分析框架，用于交流弹热效应测量，能够重建绝对熵和比热，并应用于Sr₂RuO₄超导体的相图研究。
AI.motivation: 单轴压力是量子材料的重要调控参数，但在应变装置的受限几何中，传统热力学探针（如比热测量）难以实现，因此需要新的方法来获取绝对熵和比热信息。
AI.method: 结合低频强耦合区和高频准绝热区的高信噪比测量，实现绝对精度的熵重建，从而推导出绝对比热。
AI.result: 获得了Sr₂RuO₄超导体跨相图（包括深入超导态的相变）的绝对熵图，并推导出绝对比热。数据证实超导体中熵的猝灭在临界应变处最强，与超导能隙在Van Hove奇点处最大化一致；同时发现Δc/(γT)在VH应变处虽然增加，但增幅远弱于此前的间接量热实验推断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为应变条件下量子材料的绝对比热测量提供了可行途径，并修正了此前对Sr₂RuO₄超导临界行为的一些推论。

title: Atomistic Structure Generation and Neural-Network Screening of Hard Carbons to Identify High-Capacity Sodium Storage
summary: Hard carbons are established anodes for lithium-ion batteries and leading candidates for sodium-ion batteries, yet their electrochemical performance is governed by a heterogeneous network of graphitic domains, defects, and nanopores that conventional atomistic methods cannot model at the required length scales. We combine universal machine-learned interatomic potentials with the RAFFLE structure-generation framework to construct 13,096 realistic hard carbon models containing up to 4,378 atoms, matching experimentally measured densities, porosities, and sp$^2$/sp$^3$ bonding fractions. Explicit sodium intercalation of representative structures reproduces the characteristic sloping-to-plateau voltage profiles, revealing that capacity increases with decreasing carbon density and increasing porosity. To screen the full library, we train a lightweight neural-network surrogate that predicts capacity directly from the host using frozen universal-potential descriptors augmented by geometric void features. The surrogate identifies high-capacity candidates exceeding 800 mAh g$^{-1}$, which are validated by full intercalation calculations. This scalable framework links hard carbon microstructure to sodium-storage performance and provides atomistic design principles for high-capacity anodes. More broadly, the workflow enables systematic exploration of synthesis-dependent amorphous microstructures, including precursor chemistry, pyrolysis, heteroatom doping, and pore engineering, providing a route toward atomistically informed hard carbon design.

AI.tldr: 本文结合通用机器学习原子间势能（MLIP）与RAFFLE结构生成框架，构建了13,096个包含多达4,378个原子的硬碳模型，并通过钠插层计算复现了倾斜-平台电压曲线。研究者训练了一个轻量级神经网络代理模型，直接从宿主结构预测容量，成功识别出超过800 mAh g⁻¹的高容量候选材料，并经完整插层计算验证，建立了硬碳微观结构与钠存储性能之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 硬碳是锂离子电池的重要负极材料，也是钠离子电池的主要候选负极，但其电化学性能受石墨域、缺陷和纳米孔构成的异质网络调控。传统原子模拟方法无法在所需长度尺度上建模这些复杂结构，迫切需要能够生成真实硬碳模型并高效筛选高性能材料的计算方法。
AI.method: 1) 将通用机器学习原子间势能与RAFFLE结构生成框架结合，构建具有实验匹配密度、孔隙率和sp²/sp³键合比例的硬碳模型库；2) 对代表性结构进行显式钠插层模拟，复现电压曲线并建立容量与密度/孔隙率的关联；3) 训练轻量级神经网络代理模型，利用冻结的通用势描述符结合几何孔隙特征直接预测容量，对全库进行筛选。
AI.result: 构建了含13,096个模型的大规模硬碳结构数据库（最多4,378原子/模型），成功复现实验特征和钠插层的倾斜-平台电压曲线；发现容量随碳密度降低和孔隙率增加而增大；代理模型筛选出容量超过800 mAh g⁻¹的高容量候选材料，并经全插层计算验证。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展框架建立了硬碳微观结构与钠存储性能的定量联系，提供了高容量负极的原子级设计原则，并可为前驱体化学、热解条件、杂原子掺杂和孔隙工程等合成参数驱动的非晶微结构系统探索铺平道路，实现原子层面信息指导的硬碳设计。

title: Gauge-constrained Spinon Complexes Near Deconfined Quantum Criticality
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures + supplemental materials 10 pages, 9 figures
summary: Quantum magnets provide a microscopic platform for studying confinement and gauge-constrained structures mediated by emergent gauge fields. We investigate confined spinon complexes in the columnar valence-bond-solid (VBS) phase near deconfined quantum criticality using pinned-spin defects and quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The pinned spins act as static spinon sources with controlled positions, spin projections, and VBS vorticities, enabling measurement of defect energies and direct real-space visualization of the associated VBS domain-wall strings. For matched spinon-antispinon sources, the excitation energy saturates beyond a characteristic separation as one extended dipole reorganizes into two shorter neutral dipoles, providing energetic and real-space evidence of string breaking. We further show that domain-wall connectivity is governed by lattice-scale VBS phase offsets in addition to vorticity and spin-projection neutrality. Compatible multi-pin patterns generate connected four-spinon complexes and extended domain-wall networks that retain their global connectivity under local distortions. These results establish pinned-spin defects as a controlled tool for assembling and resolving multi-spinon structures and their confining strings in a VBS phase.

AI.tldr: 本文利用钉扎自旋缺陷和量子蒙特卡洛模拟，在柱状价键固体（VBS）相中研究了受限的旋子（spinon）复合体及其弦断裂现象，建立了钉扎自旋缺陷作为可控工具来组装和解析多旋子结构的方法。
AI.motivation: 量子磁体为研究禁闭和规范约束结构提供了微观平台，但如何可控地组装和直接可视化观察旋子复合体及其限制性弦结构仍然是一个挑战，尤其是在接近去禁闭量子临界点的VBS相中。
AI.method: 采用钉扎自旋缺陷作为静态旋子源，通过控制其位置、自旋投影和VBS涡度，结合量子蒙特卡洛模拟测量缺陷能量并直接进行VBS畴壁弦的实空间可视化。
AI.result: 匹配的自旋子-反自旋子源在特征分离距离之外激发能量饱和，表现为一个扩展偶极子重组为两个较短的"电中性"偶极子，提供了弦断裂的能量和实空间证据。另外发现畴壁连通性不仅由涡度和自旋投影中性决定，还受晶格尺度VBS相位偏移的调控。兼容的多钉扎模式可生成连接的四旋子复合体和扩展畴壁网络，且这些网络在局部畸变下保持全局连通性。
AI.conclusion: 钉扎自旋缺陷是一种可控工具，可用于在VBS相中组装和解析多旋子结构及其限制性弦，为研究禁闭和规范约束结构提供了新的实验与理论手段。

title: Benchmarking Least-Squares Tensor Hypercontraction Techniques for Molecular Systems
summary: Finding a low-rank approximation for the two-electron integral (ERI) tensor is a crucial step towards reducing the computational cost of many-body electronic structure methods. In recent years, a range of new tensor factorization techniques, like the so-called tensor-hypercontraction (THC) approach, have been developed to achieve this goal. Unfortunately, a systematic comparison of accuracy and efficiency of different THC construction algorithms is missing. In this work, we address this gap by benchmarking these techniques across a wide range of molecular systems. In addition to offering useful insights into the advantages and disadvantages of the different techniques, we provide reference implementations in the newly developed open-source library, PyTHC.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地对比了多种张量超收缩（THC）构造算法在双电子积分（ERI）张量低秩近似中的准确性和效率，并在广泛分子体系上进行了基准测试，同时提供了开源库PyTHC中的参考实现。
AI.motivation: 双电子积分张量的低秩近似对降低多体电子结构方法的计算成本至关重要，近年来涌现了多种THC类张量分解技术，但缺乏对这些不同THC构造算法在准确性和效率上的系统性比较。
AI.method: 在广泛的分子体系范围内，对多种THC构造算法进行基准测试，系统比较各技术的准确性和效率，并在新开发的开源库PyTHC中提供参考实现。
AI.result: 提供了不同THC技术优缺点的重要见解，并发布了包含参考实现的开源库PyTHC。
AI.conclusion: 填补了THC构造算法缺乏系统对比的空白，为研究人员选择合适的方法提供了指导，并通过开源实现促进了该领域的发展。

title: Windmill Spin Dynamics and Its Induced Anomalous Hall Effect in Noncollinear Antiferromagnet Mn3Sn
summary: We demonstrate that the spin dynamics of the noncollinear antiferromagnet Mn\textsubscript{3}Sn possesses a special soft eigen mode, which starts as a small-angle oscillation and eventually develops into a large-angle, windmill-type precession, when the canting angle surpasses a threshold value determined by the bending of the spin order. Such windmill precession possesses a unique chiral direction of motion, which can be sensed by electrons, producing a Berry curvature through the Berry connection polarizability in the mixed parameter space. Such Berry curvature can then yield a characteristic static anomalous Hall effect during windmill precession, even though the anomalous Hall effect from the equilibrium spin order vanishes. Our work reveals rich dynamical information in noncollinear antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非共线反铁磁体Mn₃Sn的自旋动力学，发现其具有一种特殊的软本征模式——风车型进动，该模式在倾斜角超过阈值时从小角度振荡发展为大幅进动，并产生独特的反常霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 探索非共线反铁磁体中超越平衡态自旋序的动力学信息，特别是发现平衡态下无反常霍尔效应但动力学过程中能产生可探测磁电响应的新机制。
AI.method: 通过理论分析Mn₃Sn的自旋动力学，识别出软本征模式，研究倾斜角阈值条件，并利用Berry连接极化率在混合参数空间中计算Berry曲率，从而推导出风车进动期间的静态反常霍尔效应。
AI.result: 发现当自旋序弯曲导致的倾斜角超过阈值时，软模式演化为大角度风车型进动，具有手性运动方向，电子可感知该手性并通过Berry连接极化率产生Berry曲率，进而产生静态反常霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作揭示了非共线反铁磁体中丰富的动力学信息，证明即使平衡态自旋序的反常霍尔效应为零，动力学过程中的软模式进动仍可产生可测量的霍尔响应。

title: Flat band and Bulk-Boundary correspondence in a non-Hermitian trimerized lattice model with generic boundary conditions
summary: We consider a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger(SSH)-type trimer model with next-nearest-neighbor(NNN) interaction and balanced loss-gain(BLG) to study the combined effect of lattice symmetries, topology, non-hermiticity and general boundary conditions(GBC)on the existence of flat band and the nature of Bulk-Boundary correspondence(BBC). We derive the necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of an entirely real spectrum under the periodic boundary condition(PBC). The exact expressions for the compact localized states(CLS) and energy eigenvalues corresponding to flat bands are derived analytically under the PBC. We establish topological phase transitions(TPT) for PT-symmetry and pseudo-chiral symmetry through the computation of the Zak phase and sub-lattice Zak phase, respectively. The Hamiltonian under the open boundary condition(OBC) is studied numerically, and edge states are observed in the topologically non-trivial phase, thereby establishing the non-hermitian BBC. The CLS exists in both bulk and the boundary for systems having only pseudo-chiral symmetry, and an additional PT-symmetry destroys the CLS at the boundary. We generalize a known formalism to study the same Hamiltonian under GBC, and derive analytic expressions for the energy and eigenstates for a class of boundary conditions in parametric ranges which admit flat band under the PBC. The edge states for these boundary conditions, including the OBC, are obtained analytically in the topologically non-trivial phase, thereby establishing BBC. The non-hermitian skin effect(NHSE) is seen in the model with reciprocal bulk interaction and strongly non-reciprocal boundary terms. The winding number based on spectral topology is computed analytically.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有次近邻相互作用和平衡增益-损耗的SSH型三聚体模型，综合探讨了晶格对称性、拓扑性、非厄米性和一般边界条件对平带存在性及体-边对应关系的影响。作者推导了周期边界条件下全实谱存在的充要条件，解析得到了平带的紧致局域态和能量本征值，通过Zak相位和子格Zak相位建立了PT对称性和赝手性对称性的拓扑相变，并推广了现有形式论以研究一般边界条件下的能量和本征态解析表达式，建立了非厄米体-边对应。
AI.motivation: 当前研究需要理解非厄米系统中平带、拓扑相变和体-边对应的综合作用，特别是在具有次近邻相互作用和平衡增益-损耗的模型中，一般边界条件对系统物理性质的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用解析推导与数值计算相结合的方法：(1)推导PBC下全实谱存在的充要条件；(2)解析求解平带对应的CLS和能量本征值；(3)通过Zak相位和子格Zak相位表征拓扑相变；(4)数值研究OBC下的边缘态；(5)推广已知形式论处理一般边界条件，解析推导能量和本征态。
AI.result: 建立了非厄米BBC；发现CLS在仅有赝手性对称性时存在于体态和边界，而额外的PT对称性会破坏边界处的CLS；在拓扑非平凡相中解析获得了包括OBC在内的边界条件下的边缘态；在具有互易体相互作用和强非互易边界项的模型中观察到了非厄米趋肤效应，并解析计算了基于谱拓扑的绕数。
AI.conclusion: 综合展示了SSH型三聚体模型中对称性、拓扑、非厄米性和边界条件之间的复杂相互作用，为理解非厄米拓扑系统中的平带物理和体-边对应提供了新的理论框架。

title: Frustration without Glass in Non-Abelian Simplicial Networks
summary: We formulate a non-Abelian theory of structural consistency for systems in which dynamical transformations reside on the links of a simplicial network. Gauge covariance follows from freedom to choose local representation frames, while plaquette holonomies quantify the incompatibility of alternative paths. For an SU(2) model on the complete simplicial $2$-complex with quenched random plaquette couplings, parallel-tempering simulations reveal a continuous disorder-driven loss of global compatibility. In the high-disorder phase, the uniform compatibility $M_P$ decreases with system size, the integrated adjacent correlation weight $\mathcal I_{\mathrm{adj}}$ remains finite value. Moreover, the connected replica-overlap width approaches the numerical noise floor and its distribution narrows, providing no evidence for thermodynamic replica-symmetry breaking. Dense frustration therefore produces a non-glassy correlated gauge liquid in which individual pair correlations are geometrically diluted while a finite integrated correlation weight survives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非阿贝尔结构一致性理论，用于描述动力学变换位于单纯复形网络边上的系统。通过规范协变性、plaquette holonomy等概念，研究了SU(2)模型在完全单纯2-复形上的行为。平行回火模拟揭示了由无序驱动的连续全局兼容性丧失，高无序相表现为非玻璃态的关联规范液体。
AI.motivation: 传统结构一致性理论大多基于阿贝尔群框架，对于更一般的非阿贝尔变换（如SU(2)）缺乏系统的理论描述。需要建立统一的非阿贝尔理论框架来理解规范对称性与系统结构一致性之间的关系，特别是无序对全局兼容性的影响。
AI.method: 构建非阿贝尔结构一致性理论：将动力学变换置于单纯网络的链路上，利用规范协变性定义局域表示帧的自由度，用plaquette holonomy量化不同路径间的不可兼容性。对完全单纯2-复形上的SU(2)模型施加淬火随机plaquette耦合，采用平行回火（parallel tempering）模拟方法，分析M_P、积分相邻关联权重I_adj及连接副本重叠宽度等观测量。
AI.result: 发现无序驱动的连续相变导致全局兼容性丧失。高无序相中统一兼容性M_P随系统尺寸减小，积分相邻关联权重I_adj保持有限值。连接副本重叠宽度趋近数值噪声底且分布变窄，未发现热力学副本对称破缺的证据。
AI.conclusion: 高度阻挫产生的不是玻璃态，而是一种非玻璃态的关联规范液体（correlated gauge liquid）。在其中单对关联被几何稀释，但有限的积分关联权重得以保留，表明存在一种新颖的无序物相。

title: A spin-bond theory unifying non-relativistic spin splitting and emergent spin-orbit textures
summary: Magnetic order with vanishing net magnetization can produce non-relativistic spin-split bands, broadly categorized into even-parity altermagnets and odd-parity \(p\)-wave magnets. Here, we introduce a spin-bond theory that unifies these seemingly distinct phenomena into a single algebraic framework. We demonstrate that non-relativistic spin textures are fundamentally governed by two components of the electronic bond: unitary spin phases and Hermitian spin amplitudes. The unitary sector generates odd-parity p-wave and emergent spin-orbit-like textures, while the Hermitian sector generates even-parity spin fields, including the uniform \(Γ\)-split and bond-structured altermagnetic limits. Beyond unifying known phases, our theory uncovers a mixed non-commuting regime that emerges when the unitary and Hermitian sectors fail to commute, revealing an underlying non-commuting spin-bond structure. This regime generates a non-coplanar spin texture characterized by an even-in-momentum transverse spin polarization, providing a direct spectroscopic fingerprint for spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Furthermore, we establish that this synthetic spin-orbit coupling can be dynamically tuned by geometrically controlling the non-commutation of the bond sectors. By providing a microscopic foundation for such tuning, our theory paves the way for advanced applications, including field-free spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"自旋键理论"(spin-bond theory)，将交错磁体(altermagnets)和p波磁体(p-wave magnets)统一在一个代数框架中。该理论揭示非相对论自旋纹理由电子键的两个分量——酉自旋相位和厄米自旋振幅——共同决定，并发现了两者不可交换时产生的混合非对易区，该区域产生非共面自旋纹理，可被自旋分辨光电子能谱直接探测，并为无场自旋量子比特等应用提供基础。
AI.motivation: 传统上，零净磁化但产生非相对论自旋劈裂带的磁有序被分为两类：偶宇称交错磁体和奇宇称p波磁体。这些现象看似截然不同，缺乏统一的代数框架来解释和联系它们，也未能揭示更深层的新物理。
AI.method: 作者提出自旋键理论，将自旋纹理归因于电子键的两个分量：酉自旋相位(生成奇宇称p波和类自旋轨道纹理)和厄米自旋振幅(生成偶宇称自旋场，包括均匀Γ劈裂和键结构交错磁极限)。当两者不可对易时，理论预言了一个混合非对易态，产生非共面自旋纹理，其特征为动量偶次的横向自旋极化。
AI.result: 理论成功统一了交错磁体和p波磁体，发现了新的非对易混合区，该区产生的非共面自旋纹理可作为自旋角分辨光电子能谱的直接光谱指纹。还证明这种合成自旋轨道耦合可通过几何调控键的非对易性实现动态调节。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为合成自旋轨道耦合的动态调控提供了微观基础，为无场自旋量子比特等先进应用铺平了道路。

title: Fresnel diffraction imaging of surface nanostructure using coherent resonant X-ray scattering
summary: We investigated surface nanostructures on an antiferromagnet MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ using a novel imaging technique, direct (real)-space and real time coherent X-ray imaging (direct-CXI). This technique has provided new insights into antiferromagnetic textures, including the formation of anti-phase antiferromagnetic (AFM) domains and thermal dynamics of AFM domains and domain walls. While this method produces real-space images of AFM textures without requiring a complex imaging retrieval process, its underlying imaging mechanism has not been fully understood, limiting a deep understanding of AFM textures and the information they contain. By investigating the well-defined structural characteristics of the nanostructures fabricated on MnBi$_2$Te$_4$, we elucidate the imaging principle of this novel technique. We find that the observed images can be well explained by Fresnel diffraction integral. Using a simple model from classical optics, our calculations successfully reproduce the experimentally observed images of the nanostructures. This demonstrates that direct-CXI not only provides straightforward real-space imaging but also contains phase information through its Fresnel diffraction integral.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究MnBi₂Te₄反铁磁体上的表面纳米结构，揭示了直接相干X射线成像（direct-CXI）技术的成像原理。研究发现该技术产生的图像可以用菲涅尔衍射积分完美解释，并通过经典光学模型成功重现了实验观测图像，证明direct-CXI不仅提供实空间成像，还包含相位信息。
AI.motivation: direct-CXI是一种新颖的成像技术，能够直接获取反铁磁（AFM）纹理的实空间图像而无需复杂的图像重建过程，但其底层成像机制尚未被完全理解，这限制了对AFM纹理及其所含信息的深入理解。因此需要阐明该技术的成像原理。
AI.method: 利用MnBi₂Te₄上制备的具有明确结构特征的纳米结构作为研究对象，通过菲涅尔衍射积分来解释观测图像。采用经典光学中的简单模型进行计算，将理论计算结果与实验观测图像进行对比验证。
AI.result: 研究发现direct-CXI观测到的图像可以通过菲涅尔衍射积分很好地解释，使用经典光学简单模型的计算成功重现了实验中观测到的纳米结构图像。
AI.conclusion: 直接-CXI不仅提供直接的实空间成像，其菲涅尔衍射积分中还包含相位信息，这为该技术的进一步应用和对反铁磁纹理的深入理解奠定了基础。

title: Robust stabilization of high-frequency magnetic droplets in W-CoFeB-MgO nanoconstriction spin Hall nano-oscillators
summary: Magnetic droplets are highly nonlinear spin-wave solitons that can be excited in nanoscale spintronic devices with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Although extensively studied in nanocontact-based spin-torque oscillators, their stabilization in pure spin current-driven devices such as spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) has remained elusive. Here, we micromagnetically demonstrate the robust stabilization of non-propagating high-frequency droplets in CMOS-compatible W/CoFeB/MgO nanoconstriction SHNOs under oblique magnetic fields. While the constriction geometry gives rise to noncircular droplet shapes in an inhomogeneous effective field landscape, stable droplet modes exhibiting complete core magnetization reversal and pronounced hysteresis are observed. At lower current densities, droplets display breathing oscillations with periodic expansion and contraction, whereas higher drive currents lead to drift, deformation, and the emergence of sidebands around the fundamental frequency. Tuning the strength and orientation of the applied magnetic field alters the effective field landscape, allowing droplets to escape confinement and propagate over distances exceeding 2$μ$m.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁学模拟，首次在CMOS兼容的W/CoFeB/MgO纳米收缩自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNOs）中，于斜磁场条件下实现了非传播高频磁滴子的稳健稳定化，并揭示了其呼吸振荡、漂移变形及逃逸传播等丰富动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 磁滴子作为高非线性自旋波孤子，虽在纳米接触自旋转矩振荡器中已得到广泛研究，但在纯自旋电流驱动器件（如SHNOs）中的稳定化一直难以实现，亟需探索其稳定条件与动力学特性。
AI.method: 采用微磁学模拟方法，在W/CoFeB/MgO纳米收缩SHNOs结构中，施加斜磁场以研究磁滴子的激发与稳定化过程，系统分析了不同电流密度和磁场条件对滴子行为的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：收缩几何导致非圆形滴子形状并伴随完整的核心磁化反转和显著磁滞；低电流密度下滴子呈现周期性膨胀收缩的呼吸振荡，高电流密度下发生漂移、变形并在基频周围产生边带；调节磁场强度和方向可改变有效场景观，使滴子逃离约束并传播超过2μm。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明在斜磁场辅助下，CMOS兼容SHNOs中可实现稳健的高频磁滴子稳定化，为基于磁滴子的自旋电子器件实际应用提供了新的途径，并展示了调控滴子动力学行为的多种手段。

title: Heat capacity as a marker for shape and jamming transitions in active systems
summary: Persistence influences the stationary states of active particles, producing boundary accumulation at the single-particle level, and clustering or jamming in interacting systems. These features disappear as the persistence decreases and the system approaches a more passive-like stationary state. We show that these transitions have a distinct calorimetric signature. Using a lattice run-and-tumble dynamics, consistent with local detailed balance, we compute the nonequilibrium heat capacity from the excess heat released following a small temperature perturbation. For a single particle confined between reflecting boundaries, the heat capacity develops a maximum in the persistence regime corresponding to shape transition. Adding an exclusion interaction to the active particles on a periodic lattice, the reorganization of jammed clusters produces a corresponding peak in the thermal response. We also discuss the impact of the time-symmetric part of the transition rates, and show the possibility of seeing the same signatures of heat response in experiments by AC calorimetry. Our results show that nonequilibrium heat capacities can serve as calorimetric probes of nonequilibrium phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过晶格run-and-tumble动力学模型，研究了活性粒子系统中持久性（persistence）相关的相变在热量学上的特征信号，发现非平衡热容可以作为探测非平衡相变的量热探针。
AI.motivation: 活性粒子系统的持久性会导致边界堆积、聚集或堵塞等非平衡相变现象，这些现象在持久性降低时会消失。然而，如何通过热量学方法来探测这些非平衡相变尚不清楚，作者希望寻找这些转变的独特热量学特征。
AI.method: 采用满足局域细致平衡的晶格run-and-tumble动力学模型，通过小温度扰动后释放的过剩热量计算非平衡热容。分别研究：(1) 单粒子在反射边界间的约束系统；(2) 周期晶格上带排他相互作用的活性粒子系统。同时探讨跃迁率时间对称部分的影响，并提出通过AC量热法在实验中观测的方案。
AI.result: 单粒子系统的热容在持久性区间出现最大值，对应形状转变；加入排他相互作用后，堵塞团簇的重组在热响应中产生相应的峰。时间对称部分的跃迁率会影响这些信号，但核心热量学特征保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 非平衡热容能够作为探测非平衡相变的量热探针，这些热量学信号可以通过AC量热法在实验中观察到。

title: Observation of magnetic quantum phase crossovers in a semiconductor spin ladder
summary: Understanding collective phases of strongly correlated quantum magnets relies on theoretically tractable model systems with precise microscopic control. Antiferromagnetic spin ladders provide such a setting, hosting field-tunable gapped and gapless phases at half filling and unconventional pairing tendencies upon doping. Here, we realize a programmable Heisenberg spin ladder in a half-filled germanium quantum dot array featuring site-resolved, continuously tunable exchange interactions. Under a fixed magnetic field, we vary the rung and leg coupling to map the rung-singlet, canted antiferromagnetic, and fully polarized phases. Hamiltonian-learning protocols combining equilibrium and dynamical measurements quantitatively characterize the ladder, incorporating spin-orbit interactions to reproduce the observed crossover behavior. Measurements of higher-order spin correlators -- including four-point correlations inaccessible to conventional bulk probes -- reveal signatures of the underlying phase structure despite the finite size. Our results establish germanium quantum dot arrays as a controllable platform for quantum magnetism, opening routes to investigate unconventional superconductivity in doped ladders.

AI.tldr: 本文在锗量子点阵列中实现了可编程的海森堡自旋梯，通过连续可调的交换相互作用，在固定磁场下绘制了从rung单态到倾斜反铁磁再到完全极化的相图，并利用哈密顿学习协议结合自旋轨道相互作用定量表征了该梯子。
AI.motivation: 理解强关联量子磁体的集体相需要理论上易于处理且具有精确微观控制的模型系统，而反铁磁自旋梯正是这样的平台，其表现出磁场可调的能隙和无能隙相以及掺杂后的非常规配对倾向。作者希望实现一个可编程的自旋梯模型系统来研究这些物理现象。
AI.method: 在锗量子点阵列中实现可编程的海森堡自旋梯，具有位点分辨且连续可调的交换相互作用。在固定磁场下改变rung和leg耦合以映射相图，采用结合平衡和动力学测量的哈密顿学习协议进行定量表征，并融入自旋轨道相互作用来解释交叉行为，同时测量高阶自旋关联函数（包括常规体探针无法触及的四点关联）来揭示相结构特征。
AI.result: 成功映射了rung单态、倾斜反铁磁和完全极化三个相，并通过哈密顿学习协议定量表征了自旋梯，包括自旋轨道相互作用在内能够重现观察到的交叉行为。四点自旋关联函数的测量揭示了有限尺寸下的底层相结构特征。
AI.conclusion: 锗量子点阵列被确立为研究量子磁性的可控平台，为研究掺杂自旋梯中的非常规超导性开辟了道路。

title: Critical behavior and crossover scaling in the Light-Heavy model
summary: The Light-Heavy (LH) model involves two species of particles (light and heavy) coupled with a fluctuating surface (described by tilts). The dynamics include the inherent diffusion of the particles (or tilts) as well as the drive provided by the tilts (or particles). When the two are of similar magnitude, the system lies in the unscaled (uLH) regime, while a significantly weaker drive leads to the scaled (sLH) regime. In the unscaled limit, the model exhibits an order-disorder transition characterized by the fluctuation-dominated phase ordering (FDPO). In this state, interestingly the dynamics is driven by multiple modes, giving rise to dynamic clusters. Away from the critical regime the disordered phase retains vestiges of FDPO behavior on length scales smaller than the correlation length. We examine this local FDPO-like behavior by using a scaling function that links the off-critical and critical regimes. We next turn to the scaled model and show that the multi-mode dynamics present in the unscaled regime is replaced by dynamics that is effectively controlled by a single dominant mode in the scaled regime. Concurrently, the two-point correlations change from the $\mathcal{O}(1)$ FDPO form to an anomalous long-range form that decays as $1/\sqrt{L}$. Drawing on the analogy with the sABC model, where similar anomalous correlations appear at criticality, we derive an analytical expression for the two-point correlation function using the same approach used for that model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种轻-重(LH)粒子模型，该模型包含轻、重两类粒子，它们与由倾斜描述的波动表面耦合。系统分为未缩放(uLH)和缩放(sLH)两个区域。在未缩放极限下，模型呈现由涨落主导的相序(FDPO)特征的有序-无序转变，其动力学由多模驱动。在缩放模型中，多模动力学被单一主导模式取代，两点关联从FDPO的O(1)形式转变为按1/√L衰减的异常长程形式。作者借鉴sABC模型的方法，解析推导了两点关联函数的表达式。
AI.motivation: 理解LH模型中涨落主导相序(FDPO)行为在不同尺度极限下的表现差异，特别是未缩放与缩放区域中动力学模式的本质区别，以及如何通过解析方法刻画异常长程关联。
AI.method: 作者通过缩放函数将非临界与临界区域联系起来，考察局部FDPO-like行为；对于缩放模型，通过与sABC模型类比，采用相同的方法推导两点关联函数的解析表达式。
AI.result: 1) 未缩放区域中，系统远离临界时，无序相在小于关联长度的尺度上仍保留FDPO行为特征；2) 缩放模型中，多模动力学被单一主导模式控制取代；3) 两点关联从FDPO的O(1)形式转变为随系统尺寸L按1/√L衰减的异常长程形式；4) 通过类比sABC模型成功推导出缩放模型中两点关联函数的解析表达式。
AI.conclusion: LH模型在未缩放和缩放区域表现出截然不同的物理行为：前者由多模FDPO驱动，后者由单模主导并产生异常长程关联。这些发现揭示了驱动力相对强度对系统相变动力学和关联结构的根本性影响，且缩放模型中的异常关联可通过与sABC模型的类比得到解析描述。

title: Intra-atomic magnetic octupoles and their coupling to cluster magnetic octupoles in Chiral antiferromagnets Mn$_3$Sn
summary: We demonstrate that Mn$_3$Sn hosts finite intra-atomic magnetic octupoles (AMOs) $\mathbf{o}$ in addition to the well-established cluster magnetic octupole (CMO) $\mathbf{O}$. In contrast to the cluster-scale CMO, the AMO is a site-localized magnetic multipole associated with the anisotropic intra-atomic spin density. Symmetry analysis shows that the CMO and AMO transform in the same representation, allowing a bilinear interaction of the form $-g\,\mathbf{O}\cdot\mathbf{o}$. Using first-principles calculations, we confirm the presence of finite AMO densities and show that the AMO transforms concomitantly with the CMO under rotations of the noncollinear magnetic structure, providing microscopic evidence for the coupling between them. We further show that the magnetic band splitting can be represented by projected AMO operators, with manifold-dependent effective octupolar exchange coefficients in realistic Mn$_3$Sn. The presence of AMOs has three important implications. First, we show that the nonrelativistic spin splitting of Mn$_3$Sn can be described in terms of projected AMO operators, with manifold-dependent effective octupolar exchange coefficients, establishing the AMO as a microscopic operator underlying the spin splitting. Second, the AMO reveals a close connection between Mn$_3$Sn and $d$-wave altermagnets from the magnetic-octupole perspective. Third, the $\mathbf{O}\cdot\mathbf{o}$ coupling suggests a new route to manipulate the CMO using AMO currents, opening a direction for controlling the multipolar order in Mn$_3$Sn.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Mn₃Sn除已知的团簇磁八极子(CMO)外，还拥有有限的原子内磁八极子(AMO)，两者属于同一表示并可发生双线性耦合，为其自旋分裂及磁多极调控提供了新的微观视角。
AI.motivation: Mn₃Sn已被确立为具有非共线磁结构的材料，其团簇尺度的磁八极子(CMO)与反常霍尔效应等性质相关。然而，原子尺度的局域磁多极（尤其是原子内磁八极子AMO）的存在及其与CMO的关系此前未被系统研究，作者希望从微观多极角度更深入地理解Mn₃Sn的磁性及自旋分裂机制。
AI.method: 作者首先通过对称性分析证明CMO与AMO属于同一不可约表示，从而允许形如-g O·o的双线性耦合项。随后利用第一性原理计算验证Mn₃Sn中确实存在有限的AMO密度，并考察AMO在非共线磁结构旋转下与CMO的协同变换行为。最后，他们利用投影AMO算符描述磁能带分裂，并提取依赖于能带流形的有效八极交换系数。
AI.result: 第一性原理计算确认了AMO的存在并证明其与CMO协同变换；磁能带分裂可由投影AMO算符描述，且有效八极交换系数与能带流形相关。此外，AMO建立了Mn₃Sn与d波交替磁体之间的磁八极联系，而O·o耦合则提供了通过AMO电流操控CMO的新途径。
AI.conclusion: AMO是Mn₃Sn中自旋分裂的微观算符，揭示了其与d波交替磁体的深层联系，并提出了一种通过AMO电流操控磁八极序的新调控策略，为多极磁性材料的物性调控开辟了新的方向。

title: The Deformed Image Vortex Ansatz: A Perturbation-Aware Description of Magnetic Vortices in In-Plane Fields
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Includes Supplemental Material (Secs. S1-S6) appended to the main text
summary: Thiele-based descriptions of magnetic vortex dynamics in thin ferromagnetic nanodots rely on magnetization ansätze that describe the equilibrium texture but cannot represent perturbation-induced deformations. We introduce the Deformed Image Vortex Ansatz (DIVA): a perturbation-aware ansatz in which the response to an external perturbation is built into the magnetization profile itself, rather than appended to the dynamics as a correction. Here, we demonstrate the concept for a uniform, stationary in-plane field applied to a Permalloy nanodot, for which the deformation is analytically tractable. A symmetry-based perturbative expansion identifies the leading deformation as a single $m = 1$ harmonic around the disk, while energy minimization and a dominant-balance analysis yield a closed-form interpolant for the radial profile. Benchmarked against micromagnetic simulations on Permalloy disks of aspect ratio $t/R = 0.1$ and $0.0125$, this realization reduces the disk-averaged angular deviation by a factor of 3 to 6 relative to the two-vortex ansatz, depending on geometry and field, and reduces the total-energy deviation by about a factor of six in the thicker disk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种形变图像涡旋Ansatz（DIVA），这是一种扰动感知的磁化分布假说，将外部扰动响应直接构建在磁化轮廓中，而非作为动力学的修正项附加。在均匀静态面内场作用于坡莫合金纳米盘的场景下，通过对称性微扰展开识别出主导形变为m=1谐波，并结合能量最小化与主平衡分析得到径向剖面的闭式插值。与微磁模拟对比，该方案相对于双涡旋Ansatz将盘平均角度偏差降低3-6倍，总能量偏差降低约6倍。
AI.motivation: 基于Thiele方程的磁涡旋动力学描述依赖磁化ansätze，但这些ansätze只能描述平衡纹理，无法表示扰动引起的形变，限制了动力学描述的精度。
AI.method: 提出DIVA（形变图像涡旋Ansatz），将外部扰动的响应内嵌到磁化轮廓本身。采用对称性微扰展开识别主导形变为m=1谐波，通过能量最小化与主平衡分析推导径向剖面的闭式插值公式。
AI.result: 在坡莫合金盘（t/R=0.1和0.0125）上与微磁模拟对比，DIVA将盘平均角度偏差相对双涡旋ansatz降低3-6倍（取决于几何与场），在较厚盘中总能量偏差降低约6倍。
AI.conclusion: DIVA作为一种扰动感知ansatz，能显著提升磁涡旋动力学描述的精度，为后续在Thiele框架下实现更精确的涡旋动力学建模提供了基础。

title: Growth of Altermagnetic α-MnTe Films: Substrate Variation and Surface Modification
summary: Manganese telluride (MnTe) in its hexagonal α-MnTe crystal structure has evolved as one of the altermagnet workhorse materials. The synthesis of MnTe thin films is highly relevant for both fundamental science and device applications. Here, we report on the epitaxial growth of MnTe thin films and heterostructures. The films are studied by X-ray and electron diffraction as well as soft X-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. We demonstrate the ability to grow high-quality α-MnTe on various substrates, ranging from transparent band insulators, over topological insulators, metallic transition metal chalcogenides, to the van der Waals ferromagnet Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$. While insulating substrates are useful for transport experiments or optical spectroscopy, metallic topological surface states may trigger spintronic interface effects, such as spin-orbit torques. Metallic substrates, in general, are highly relevant to avoid charging at the insulating MnTe films in electron spectroscopy or microscopy methods. Lastly, ferromagnetic substrates will be of interest to control magnetization across the interface. In addition, we discuss the formation of superstructures on the MnTe(0001) surfaces, that emerge directly after growth, upon subsequent tellurium evaporation and after thermal treatment. This will be relevant in further studying the surface magnetic and electronic structure in α-MnTe.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了α-MnTe（反铁磁交变磁体材料）薄膜及异质结构的外延生长研究。作者展示了在多种衬底（从透明带绝缘体、拓扑绝缘体、金属过渡金属硫族化合物到范德华铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂）上生长高质量α-MnTe薄膜的能力，并通过X射线衍射、电子衍射和软X射线角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）对薄膜进行了系统表征。此外，文章还讨论了MnTe(0001)表面上超结构的形成及其对表面磁性和电子结构研究的意义。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe作为交变磁体（altermagnet）的代表性材料，其薄膜合成对基础科学和器件应用至关重要。然而，在不同类型衬底上可控生长高质量α-MnTe薄膜仍是一个关键挑战，特别是需要探索不同衬底对薄膜性能及界面效应的影响，以满足输运实验、光谱学、自旋电子学等不同研究需求。
AI.method: 采用外延生长方法在多种衬底上制备MnTe薄膜及异质结构，包括带绝缘体、拓扑绝缘体、金属过渡金属硫族化合物和范德华铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂。利用X射线衍射和电子衍射表征晶体结构，采用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）研究电子结构。同时通过退火和碲蒸发等工艺调控表面超结构的形成。
AI.result: 成功在多种不同类型衬底上实现了高质量α-MnTe薄膜的外延生长。绝缘体衬底适用于输运实验和光学光谱表征；金属衬底可避免电子能谱和显微方法中的充电效应；拓扑绝缘体衬底的金属表面态可能触发自旋轨道力矩等自旋电子学界面效应；铁磁衬底有望通过界面控制磁化方向。同时观察到了MnTe(0001)表面在生长后、碲蒸发后和热处理后的超结构形成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了α-MnTe薄膜在不同功能衬底上的普适性外延生长能力，为交变磁体的基础物理研究和自旋电子学器件应用提供了材料平台。不同衬底选择对应不同的研究场景和应用需求，而表面超结构的可控形成为进一步研究α-MnTe的表面磁性和电子结构奠定了基础。

title: Dynamics of Majorana tetron qubits under quasiparticle poisoning
summary: We study the dissipative dynamics of a Majorana tetron qubit in the presence of extrinsic quasiparticle poisoning due to the coupling to external leads. From the Bloch-Redfield equation describing a finite-size topological superconductor hosting four Majorana zero modes, we recover analytical expressions for the steady state, the parity leakage rate, and the decoherence rate of a Majorana qubit at arbitrary values of the charging energy. The analysis shows that the exponential suppression of the dephasing rate is gradually removed by the energy splitting of the qubit states. These results can be useful to understand time-domain experimental data in Majorana qubit prototypes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Majorana tetron量子比特在外部引线耦合导致的外在准粒子毒化作用下的耗散动力学。通过Bloch-Redfield方程，作者推导出稳态、宇称泄漏率和退相干率的解析表达式，发现能级劈裂会逐渐消除退相率的指数抑制效应。
AI.motivation: Majorana量子比特是拓扑量子计算的重要候选方案，但在实际实验中，外在准粒子毒化效应会破坏其拓扑保护性。理解有限尺寸拓扑超导体中Majorana四模式系统的耗散动力学，对于解释时间域实验数据至关重要。
AI.method: 基于Bloch-Redfield方程，对包含四个Majorana零模的有限尺寸拓扑超导体进行量子主方程分析，在任意充电能量下解析求解稳态、宇称泄漏率和退相干率。
AI.result: 研究发现，量子比特态的能级劈裂会逐步移除退相率的指数抑制效应，即拓扑保护的退相干抑制随能级分裂而减弱。
AI.conclusion: 这些解析结果可为理解Majorana量子比特原型器件的时域实验数据提供理论指导。

title: Multiple topological electronic and phononic quasiparticle excitations in hexagonal TTe (T=Hf, Zr & Ti) crystals
summary: The exploration of topological fermions and bosons marks a new chapter in condensed matter physics, unveiling rich and unconventional phenomena. Particularly in quantum field theory, exotic quasiparticle excitations such as Dirac and Weyl fermions can serve as direct analogs, and their recent experimental realizations have sparked significant interest in these topological quasiparticles. Although there are various reports on the coexistence of unconventional fermionic quasiparticles such as spin-1/2 (type-I, type-II, & type-III), spin-1 (threefold degeneracy), nodal line (type-I, type-II, & type-III) and others, reports on the simultaneous presence of such quasiparticles in both electronic and phononic spectra within a single material remain extremely limited. Herein, using state-of-theart ab initio calculations, we propose the HfTe class of materials, which hosts coexisting type-I, type-II, and type-III Weyl and nodal line phases, along with pseudospin-1/spin-1 quasiparticles in both electronic and phononic states. We have found that these excitations are robust against variations in exchange-correlation functionals, spin-orbit coupling, and lattice parameters, confirming that multiple topological phases in this class of materials are likely to be observed experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算提出HfTe类材料，该材料在电子和声子谱中同时共存多种拓扑准粒子（包括type-I/II/III型Weyl和节点线相，以及赝自旋-1/自旋-1准粒子），且这些拓扑相对外交换相关泛函、自旋轨道耦合和晶格参数的变化具有鲁棒性。

AI.method: 采用最先进的第一性原理（ab initio）计算，对HfTe类材料的电子能带和声子谱进行分析，系统研究了拓扑准粒子的共存情况，并验证了这些拓扑相在不同交换相关泛函、自旋轨道耦合强度及晶格参数下的稳定性。
